description:
Want some amazing photos of your trip to NYC and don't have a lot previous experience in front of the camera? Then this is definitely the experience for you!

I will show you the best Brooklyn bridge/Dumbo hidden photo spots and help you relax in front of the camera giving you poses and things to do making sure you get those insta-worthy photos :)

I do my best to make you feel like you are just out taking photos with a friend!

**Unlike some other photographers on here I never charge for photos. ALL PHOTOS ARE FREE with the shoot** Within five days your photos have been edited to perfection, uploaded to your online gallery and ready for you to share with family and friends!
hostdescription:
As a head photographer at www.travelflash.co i have shoot many celebrities like Ariana Grande, Nicki Minaj and Samuel L Jackson.

After doing photoshoots in Dumbo for many years i have perfected and discovered the best Dumbo photo-spots and i will take you to 7 of them capturing lifetime memories. I'm excited to meet you and give you a great souvenir of your time in NYC :)

For sample photos visit our Instagram @Travelflashnyc
locationDescription: We will get some amazing variety of photos on both Brooklyn bridge and in DUMBO. I will take you to 6 different spots.

reviews.text: We highly recommend this experience! Jesmin, was fantastic and so talented! She made us feel comfortable and helped us pose. If you are looking for someone to capture your trip, she is the one!

As someone with a decade of professional photography experience, I was looking for someone I could trust to take the types of pictures I’d take on my own and Jasmin surpassed my expectations. I usually do self portraits since I’m usually disappointed by other people’s photos of me, but in the interest of time and comfort, I decided to hire someone to do it for me so I could enjoy my vacation and focus on other things. Jasmin has her stylistic settings programmed in camera so that there is very little post-production editing involved (meaning, what you see on the camera is what you can expect to get-no surprises). She is totally open to suggestions, will make sure you look appropriate before snapping the picture and allows you to see how the pictures are coming out as she shoots. There was another couple there during our shoot, but it doesn’t at all interfere with your personal individualized experience. She’s friendly and knows what she’s doing. 10/10 would book again!

We also didn’t get the full 1 hour experience since she was running 20 min late and then had to cut our time short to make it to her next appointment on time. I still recommend her overall, but to those who like to have things planned ahead of time, just be prepared to have last min changes to the schedule!
